Subject: Birchley Warehousing - Quote Request

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the submission on Birchley Warehousing! I've reviewed the materials and everything looks good to move forward with a quote.

I have a few questions before I can finalize pricing:

- Can you provide details on the fire protection systems at both locations (sprinklers, alarms, monitoring)?
- What commodities are stored, and are any considered hazardous?
- What is the building construction type for each location?
- Are there any tenant operations, or is this owner-occupied only?

Once I have these details, I'll work up competitive terms for the 1/10/2027 effective date.

Thanks, and looking forward to working with you on this one!

Best,
[Underwriter name]
